description:
Calculate the confluence (percentage of area covered by cells) of the HeLa cell phase contrast image located at ~/Fiji_Data/raw/confluence/hela-cells.tif.

Perform the following steps:
1. Open the image (it is a 16-bit or 12-bit phase contrast image).
2. Pre-process the image to highlight cell bodies and separate them from the background (e.g., convert to 8-bit, use variance/texture filters, find edges, or morphological operations). Simple thresholding will not work due to the halo effect.
3. Create a binary mask where white pixels (255) represent cells and black pixels (0) represent background.
4. Save this binary mask to ~/Fiji_Data/results/confluence/confluence_mask.png.
5. Measure the area fraction (confluence) and save the single numeric percentage value (e.g., 78.5) to a text file at ~/Fiji_Data/results/confluence/confluence_report.txt.
